name: TrimUI Brick

pad.note: oakMOSS runs TrimUI's own trimui_inputd on the Brick (BrickOakMOSS.sh starts it), so the pad is the same virtual 'TRIMUI Player1' node as on stock, volume keys included; BrickOakMOSS.sh's oakmoss_resolve_event_paths looks it up by that name

power.note: BrickOakMOSS.sh's oakmoss_resolve_event_paths matches '*axp*pek*'/'*[Pp]ower*'/'*pwr*' generically; not separately re-measured on the oakMOSS build (the stock Brick's own axp2202-pek was measured, the lab capturesBrick-20260921.txt)

fn-switch.note: BrickOakMOSS.sh overrides oakMOSS's generic no-op stub (oakmoss_a133p.sh's device_get_switch_position, which is blank because that pin is L1 on the MagicX boards) to read the same TrimUI PH19 pin stock reads; not independently hardware-verified on an oakMOSS build

L3.label: Fn
L3.note: measured PASS as 'L3 / Brick FN1' in the 2026-10-30 hardware test; the Brick has no analog sticks, so BTN_THUMBL is wired to the left Fn key and nothing else reports it (FN_KEY_LEFT="1 317" in the inherited Brick.cfg)

R3.label: Fn
R3.note: measured PASS as 'Brick FN2' in the 2026-10-30 hardware test; BTN_THUMBR wired to the right Fn key (FN_KEY_RIGHT="1 318")

absent.HOME: cfg B_HOME=DOESNT_EXIST (inherited from tina-stock/Brick.cfg, unchanged by BrickOakMOSS.cfg)
absent.LEFT_STICK: 0 sticks (DEVICE_NUM_ANALOG_STICKS=0, inherited from Brick.cfg); the 2026-10-30 hardware test's rows 20-23 only exercised the concurrently-tested Zero 40's stick, idle on the Brick side
absent.FN_LEFT: the Fn keys are L3/R3 (317/318) on the Brick, per the tester (2026-11-11) and confirmed by the 2026-10-30 hardware test
absent.FN_RIGHT: the Fn keys are L3/R3 (317/318) on the Brick; see FN_LEFT

notes: The best-evidenced of the six for the pad itself: the 2026-10-30 guided test ran concurrently on a Brick running oakMOSS  and a Zero 40, and every Brick row PASSed, including L3/R3 as the two Fn keys and the explicit note that the Zero 40 has no R3 - independent corroboration of the Zero40.json RIGHT_STICK/R3 conflict noted there.

POWER and FN_SWITCH were not exercised in that test (POWER is rarely pressed in a guided run to avoid shutting the unit down mid-test, and no Fn-switch flip was in the prompt list); both stay cfg-only until a run checks them.
BrickOakMOSS.cfg sources the stock tina-stock/Brick.cfg verbatim for all its B_* codes, so anything that changes on a future stock Brick firmware revision should be re-checked here too.
